style: Say in a relaxed, friendly way, like a kind dad helping with homework
lines: Tap word tiles to tie them on your line. Watch which fish swim to your bobber. Then press Cast.
Free fishing. Tap any word in the tackle box, or type your own and press Add, and watch the lake.
Stuck? Tap a word on your line, then press Swap a word.
Too many to read! Tap a word tile that says what you want to know.
Nothing bit. Tap a word on your line to select it.
Little words are on every page. Tap the tiles that name your topic.
Small catch, but none of these answers the question. Tap a word on your line to select it.
Good catch! That one answers the question. Tap another level number to fish again.
No fish here know that word. Tap it on your line to select it.
Your line is full. Tap a word on your line to select it.
Press Cast to reel in the fish at your bobber.
Tap a word tile to tie it on your line.
Your catch has too many fish and your line is full. Tap a word on your line to select it.
Tap a replacement word to swap it onto your line.
Press Take it off to remove the selected word.
Same fish as before. Little words don't change the catch.
Tap a word tile to tie it on your line first.
Your catch is in the bucket. Change a word and press Cast to try again.
No swaps for that word. Press Take it off, or pick another word.
